description: Roads speed limits in Ajman is a dataset listed in Ajmandata open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Ajman Police. A table contains roads names and their speed limits. Coverage: Ajman emirate. The portal files it under Public order justice and rights. The portal shows 20 records. The portal shows 2024-07-09 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-ajman-ae-portal.
